content.text:
Here are **free online auto repair estimate** tools you can use:

1. **RepairPal Estimator** — gives local fair-price ranges by ZIP code, vehicle, and repair; some prices may be guaranteed for 30 days at certified shops. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))  
2. **Kelley Blue Book Auto Repair Pricing** — shows a “Fair Repair Range” for common repairs based on your vehicle and area. ([kbb.com](https://www.kbb.com/auto-repair/?msockid=227a79e96d9466630b0d6f876c896768&utm_source=openai))  
3. **NAPA Auto Care Repair Estimator** — estimates common repairs and maintenance by year/make/model and ZIP code; final quote requires shop inspection. ([napaonline.com](https://www.napaonline.com/en/auto-care/car-repair-estimator?utm_source=openai))  
4. **YourMechanic Instant Estimate** — free instant quotes for many mobile-mechanic services, with parts/labor breakdowns. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))  

**Tip:** For the most accurate estimate, have ready your **year, make, model, engine size, mileage, ZIP code, and the repair needed**—for example, “2016 Toyota Camry front brake pads and rotors.” Online estimates are ballparks; a shop may change the quote after diagnosis or teardown.
